summary: Tested the full RO e-Factura feature, backend and frontend. Backend: 22/22 pytest pass (config/env switch, secret hidden, OAuth authorize URL, invalid-state callback redirect, cron 401/200/400, Test-without-OAuth submit -> error 'SPV neautorizat', Simulare submit -> pending -> refresh ok, cron status poll -> ok, placeholder seller -> status invalid, invalid XML 400, non-UBL 400, sync in simulare 400). UI: the sidebar link, the /efactura page and its status texts for all 3 environments, the saved-secret placeholder, Connect disabled in Simulare, Refresh/Disconnect disabled, the logs table, and the Connect redirect to logincert.anaf.ro (intercepted, URL has client_id, redirect_uri, state) all work. Invoice panel: validate, Test-mode error, Simulare submit (index shown), refresh to 'Validată ANAF' work. Auto-send on a newly issued fiscal invoice works (SRV 000070 went to pending, then ok via cron). Inbox: importing ICR-2026-7781 auto-maps BU-HC-040 and defaults SKF to '+ Creează articol nou'. It created NIR-2026-00010: BU-HC-040 stock 10->14, SKF product created with stock 2, supplier 'Furnizor Nou Demo SRL' created. For F-1000 the duplicate alert shows and Overwrite updates NIR-2026-00001 (FU-OL-001 10->12 @27.5, FU-AE-002 unchanged 10 @45). Stock changes by the delta only, NIR-2026-00001 moves stay at 1 per product, the NIR is efactura_linked and the row shows 'Legată (overwrite)'. All core requirements pass; only minor UX and robustness issues remain.

minor.issue: TaxTotal has a single TaxSubtotal that uses the FIRST line's VAT rate on the whole net. If an invoice mixes VAT rates (e.g. 21% + 11%/9%), the XML is wrong under CIUS-RO/EN16931 (BR-CO-14 / BR-S-08) and ANAF will reject it (nok). Group the lines by vat_rate and emit one TaxSubtotal per rate. validate_ubl does not catch this.

The seller IBAN is not validated. Settings currently has iban='RO[IBAN]' (shown in red on /efactura), yet internal validation returns OK, and the IBAN goes into PaymentMeans/PayeeFinancialAccount. Add a placeholder '[' check and an IBAN format check.

On error/invalid status the old upload_index from an earlier submit is kept, and env is overwritten. The panel then shows 'EROARE STRUCTURĂ · index 4401901396 · test', an index that belongs to an earlier simulare submit. Clear upload_index when status becomes error/invalid.
A saved client_secret can never be cleared: an empty or null value is ignored. The 'Deconectare' action does not remove it either. Consider an explicit clear option.

Importing the same XML twice creates a second inbox row (no dedup on supplier CIF + series/number or on a content hash). If the NIR is already linked to the first message, the second one is a dead end: create-nir returns 409 and link returns 400 'NIR-ul este deja legat...', and the UI has no 'force' option. Warn or reject at import time.

The suffix match (len>=3, endswith) can give false positives, e.g. NIR invoice_no '100' matches 'F-1100' from the same supplier. Consider exact normalized equality, or series + number parsed separately.

asyncio.create_task is called without keeping a reference, so the task can be garbage-collected before it finishes. Its exceptions are also swallowed silently. Keep a reference set, or use BackgroundTasks.

2 fiscal invoices had the legacy status 'in_processing'. poll_pending/refresh ignore it ('pending' only), so they could never progress. During testing they were moved to 'ok'. Consider migrating legacy 'in_processing' to 'pending' or to a resend state.
Simulation sets status ok but stores no receipt file, so efactura-receipt-button never appears in simulare and the ZIP download path is untested. Optionally store a dummy ZIP for training.

ui_bugs.issue: After a successful Overwrite, the inbox-duplicate-alert with the Overwrite button stays visible and the mapping selects stay enabled. `done` comes from the stale m.status, and detail is not refetched. The user can click Overwrite again. Re-fetch detail, or set a local done state after link().
/efactura?oauth=error shows the error toast twice. The effect runs twice (StrictMode / setSp). Pass a toast id (toast.error(msg,{id:'oauth'})) or use a ref guard.

issues: Address city 'Bacau' with county_code 'RO-B' (Bucharest) is inconsistent seed data. ANAF checks county codes for RO-B (sector) and other counties, so this should be fixed in Settings.

action_items: build_ubl: emit one TaxSubtotal per VAT rate (mixed-rate invoices currently produce invalid UBL)
EfacturaInbox: hide the duplicate alert / Overwrite button and disable the selects after a successful link (refetch detail)
Clear upload_index when the e-Factura status becomes error/invalid
Inbox import: detect duplicate messages (same supplier + series/number) at upload
Keep a reference to the auto-send task (avoid GC) and log its exceptions
critical_code_review_comments: Mixed-VAT TaxSubtotal bug in efactura.build_ubl (see above). This is the most impactful issue for real ANAF submissions.
validate_ubl uses a hardcoded unit mapping (HUR/H87) and then checks it against UNECE_UNITS, so the check can never fail. Products with other units (LTR, KGM) are always sent as H87.
link_overwrite builds old = {product_id: line}. If a manual NIR has two lines with the same product, one is silently dropped, and stock/lot deltas will be wrong.
The OAuth state is only cleared on success. An invalid callback leaves it reusable until the 15-minute expiry. Acceptable, but consider clearing it on any callback.
Pytest note: config is global (singleton doc), so e-Factura tests must run with -n 0 (no xdist). Parallel workers race on the environment setting.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows work; 1 medium + 1 low UI issue)
